dimensions.question: How does a family discover which RMHC Toronto service fits its situation when House accommodation, Family Rooms, sleep spaces, school and support services use different eligibility and capacity rules?
dimensions.scopeChange: Discovery is treated as a family-role, eligibility and service-routing problem rather than ordinary lodging search.

observations.text: RMHC Toronto operates multiple hospitality/service modes rather than one uniform product.
House eligibility depends on medical context, distance, role and hospital referral.
Family Room eligibility differs from House eligibility and varies by hospital/unit.
Eligible families may still face House or sleep-space capacity limits.

unanswered: How families first discover RMHC Toronto is not established.
Referral conversion rates are unknown.
Real-time visibility of House or Family Room capacity is not public.
dimensions.reason: Service and eligibility differentiation are clear, but discovery effectiveness and unmet demand remain unverified.
dimensions.nextEvidence: Seek independent family discovery pathways, referral conversion and live capacity visibility.

observations.text: Hospital social-worker referral is part of the House access path.

dimensions.question: What must a family resolve before arrival while room availability remains uncertain and adult clearance, health-safety and hospital-unit eligibility can still affect access?

observations.text: Families may need backup accommodation because House availability is not guaranteed.
